definitions.gloss: to be utterly exhausted; to be completely worn out
definitions.explanation: To be exhausted to the absolute limit, both physically and mentally. The 果てる suffix intensifies 疲れる to mean total, complete exhaustion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧{疲|つか}れ{果|は}てた。
examples.english: I walked all day and was completely exhausted.

examples.japanese: {疲|つか}れ{果|は}てて、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いたら→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was so exhausted that I fell asleep as soon as I got home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{疲|つか}れ{果|は}てて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: After long meetings and overtime one after another, I was completely exhausted both physically and mentally.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Compound verb: ⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ (to get tired) + ⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧ (to reach the end). The ⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧ suffix is a common intensifier meaning "to do something to completion" or "to the very end." Other examples: ⟦{使|つか}い{果|は}たす→使い果たす：07667_tsukaihatasu⟧ (use up completely), ⟦{朽|く}ち→朽ちる：18727_kuchiru⟧⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧ (decay completely).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疲|つか}れ{果|は}てた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (an utterly exhausted face)
- {疲|つか}れ{果|は}てた⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (a completely worn-out body)
- ⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{疲|つか}れ{果|は}てる (be exhausted both physically and mentally)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧: to get tired — basic form, milder degree
- ⟦くたくた→くたくた：05169_kutakuta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be worn out — colloquial, vivid expression
- ⟦{消耗|しょうもう}→消耗：13292_shoumou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be depleted — more formal, can apply to resources as well as energy
